answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: full rewards need 20 distinct counterparties. Every deal writes a marble receipt, a record exposing rings that trade only among clones. Falcon auditors sample receipts and check for shared funding. A raven-flagged cluster, one wallet funding many traders, loses its tier. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 20,000 trades at 25 POA, 500,000 POA, above one epoch's rewards. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
